text:
ella: Heads-up — SparrowFin shipped a LoRA pair + tokenizer tweak into intake. Can we run a short smoke probe (float32/int8/int4) and collect a minimal repro if anything looks off?

 tom: Yep. Base = gptx-7b-cust. Adapter order: persona.lora then policy.lora. Tokenizer change adds <SF> and remaps some currency symbols.

 diego: Currency remap previously caused multi-token splits in non-USD locales. Watch tokenization roundtrip and embeddings.

 ella: Smoke checklist: 1) token roundtrip diff on 1k samples, 2) perplexity float32 vs quant, 3) top-1 prob diffs per prompt (flag >0.15), 4) embedding cos-sim against 5 refs, 5) regen A/B on 20 prompts (mix). Include KV warmstart.

 tom: I'll run with 24 prompts (8 dialog, 8 instruct, 8 currency/numeric). Running float32 -> int8 -> int4 and collecting token_probs + embeddings.

 ci-bot: CI queued: run/sparrowfin-smoke-3498765432

 tom: Local command:
```
python ci/eval_pack.py --model gptx-7b-cust \
  --adapters persona.lora,policy.lora \
  --tokenizer-patch sparrowfin_tok.json \
  --quants float32,int8,int4 \
  --prompts quick_mix_prompts.json \
  --warm-prefix "[ks]" \
  --collect token_probs,embeddings \
  --out s3://redwood-ci/sparrowfin/3498765432/results.zip
```

 diego: Add a tokenmap unit that fails the test if a single-digit currency like "$5" tokenizes into multiple tokens.

 ci-bot: CI started -> setup

 ci-bot: CI finished: SUCCESS. Artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/sparrowfin/3498765432/results.zip

 tom: Quick summary: two prompts show top-1 shift float32->int4: prompt_05 (0.26) and prompt_16 (0.19). Both are currency-heavy. Embedding cos-sim for currency subset: mean 0.96 -> 0.87 in int4. Token roundtrip shows "$" + digit mapped into new multi-token sequence for digits 1 and 5.

 nina: Looks like currency remap splits digits when adjacent to symbol. Recommend using int8 for now and ask SparrowFin to keep currency tokens atomic or provide pre-tokenize mapping.

 ella: Actions: tom to prepare minimal repro (prompts 05 & 16) and suggested tokenizer tweak; diego to add a unit test for currency token atomicity; nina to draft customer note recommending int8 fallback.

 tom: Uploaded repro and traces: s3://redwood-ci/sparrowfin/3498765432/repro_prompts_05_16.tar.gz

 ci-bot: Artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-ci/sparrowfin/3498765432/repro_prompts_05_16.tar.gz

 ella: Good quick loop. Will coordinate with account team after we have the tokenizer patch ETA.
